reason: The gap aims to compare the prevalence of hospital overnight stays among SUID cases and live births from PRAMS Phase 8. While this comparison can provide insights into whether infants who later experience SUID are more likely to have spent nights in the hospital after birth, it does not establish incidence rates or risks due to a lack of denominator source for SUID cases. It also cannot determine causality or control for confounders without additional data.
